title: データベースマネジメント
subtitle: Database Management
teachers:
HIRATA Kazufumi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
This course is for an educational goal of the Dept. of Management Systems to acquire "Information design basic ability". Students will:
(1) acquire the basic ability to utilize IT.
(2) learn the fundamental theory of relational databases.
(3) learn how to design a database, use SQL, and operate a database.
advice:
To use a database, the following three abilities are required:
  1. The ability to use SQL, a language for managing data held in a database.
  2. The ability to maintain data integrity using normalization, primary/foreign key, and so on.
  3. The ability to design application systems using a database.

Students will acquire abilities 1 and 2 mainly through lectures and exercises in the first half of the course; they will acquire ability 3 in the second half of the course.
books: The Manga Guide to Database by Mana Takahashi, Shoko Azuma, and Trend-Pro Co., Ltd., No Starch Press; ISBN: 978-1-59327-190-9
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of computers such as the basic operation of a PC, Web design, IT systems, etc.

              This course is for an educational goal of the Dept. of Management Systems to acquire "Information design basic ability". Students will:
(1) acquire the basic ability to utilize IT.
(2) learn the fundamental theory of relational databases.
(3) learn how to design a database, use SQL, and operate a database.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              To use a database, the following three abilities are required:
  1. The ability to use SQL, a language for managing data held in a database.
  2. The ability to maintain data integrity using normalization, primary/foreign key, and so on.
  3. The ability to design application systems using a database.

Students will acquire abilities 1 and 2 mainly through lectures and exercises in the first half of the course; they will acquire ability 3 in the second half of the course.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              The Manga Guide to Database by Mana Takahashi, Shoko Azuma, and Trend-Pro Co., Ltd., No Starch Press; ISBN: 978-1-59327-190-9
